method: Retrospective estimates by dominant action, manually reviewed against the original tool-call timeline.
Tool ordinals refer to work_log.json tool_log (one-based); batches with multiple purposes have one owner.
Each recorded inference is assigned to its immediately preceding tool call; one compaction shares reporting tool 104.
Elapsed time from the previous inference timestamp to the current one is charged to the current inference category.
These non-overlapping wall-time allocations include waiting and reasoning; they are not isolated process runtimes.
Background tests and rendering overlap other work. No parallel runtime is added twice.
Original counts/tokens are exact; category attribution is approximate. This follow-up analysis is excluded.
Cached input is included in input tokens; reasoning output is included in output tokens.

tests_and_validation.scope: Pytest, lint, demo and semantic checks, simulation retries, recording, and evaluation smoke execution.

reporting_overhead.scope: README and telemetry work, including the context compaction recorded during reporting.
